AE_requirement: Cohesion and friction-angle degradation parameters require data support
model_item: c_b0_prime, Delta_tan_phi, eta(t) partition between cemented cohesion and frictional contribution
primary_datasets: DesignSafe PRJ-2453/Nafisi et al. stress-path data; de Rezende et al. triaxial data; Talamkhani 2023 UCS compilation; Ahmad et al. 2026 UCS compilation; Kulkarni 2021 UCS/PLT as footing-scale consistency check
data_role: Component strength calibration/bounding; prevents fitting c-prime and phi-prime from a single composite bearing-capacity ratio
what_is_calibrated: Initial strength envelope and plausible range of cementation-induced increments
what_is_bounded: Degradation can be applied to the cementation state eta(t) rather than to arbitrary independent c-prime and phi-prime loss curves
what_is_sensitized: Stress-path dependence and extrapolation outside available cementation/grain-size ranges
not_identified: Direct time-varying c-prime/phi-prime under the same footing after long-term degradation
allowed_claim: Component-constrained strength parameterization suitable for pre-design and updating
blocked_claim: Universal calibrated c-prime/phi-prime degradation law for all MICP soils
residual_gap: Requires site-specific triaxial/direct-shear or back-calibration when used for final design

AE_requirement: Residual cementation and degradation clock require data support
model_item: eta(t), eta_r, lambda_E, environmental exposure clock
primary_datasets: Sharma et al. 2021a,b wetting-drying/ageing/freeze-thaw durability; Ribeiro and Gomez 2023 dissolution columns; Tao et al. 2025 acid/freeze-thaw bearing retention; Zhang et al. 2024 and Ji et al. 2024 field exposure evidence
data_role: Durability and dissolution calibration/bounding; converts permanent-credit assumption into exposure-conditioned retention scenarios
what_is_calibrated: Example exposure-cycle retention curves and residual-retention priors
what_is_bounded: Aggressive chemical and weathering scenarios; upper/lower envelope for retained cementation or retained bearing improvement
what_is_sensitized: Conversion from exposure cycles to calendar years and site environmental severity
not_identified: A universal annual degradation rate independent of pH, flow, wet-dry, freeze-thaw, chemistry, and temperature
allowed_claim: Data-bounded degradation scenarios with environmental-history updating
residual_gap: Needs site environmental history and monitoring/lab retention tests for final service-life prediction

AE_requirement: Treated-zone contribution function requires data support
model_item: chi_H, k_H, k_z, w(z), capped H/B treatment-depth benefit
primary_datasets: Kulkarni et al. 2021 MICP PLT/load-settlement; Pusadkar et al. 2017 MICP footing-on-slope; Martin et al. 2024 EICP field PLT analogue; open-source limit analysis, OpenSeesPy and CalculiX layered-footing audits
data_role: Footing/plate-scale trend validation and mechanistic bounding of monotonic but saturating depth benefit
evidence_status: STRONGLY BOUNDED; PARTLY CALIBRATED FOR SHORT-TERM PLT RESPONSE
what_is_calibrated: Initial load-settlement plausibility and bearing-capacity improvement ratio from direct PLT evidence
what_is_bounded: Monotonic capped H/B influence and rejection of unlimited thin-layer credit
what_is_sensitized: Geometry, setback, treated-layer thickness and field-scale analogue differences
not_identified: Systematic degraded MICP footing matrix across multiple H/B values under one soil/protocol/degradation sequence
allowed_claim: Capped treated-zone screening function consistent with external PLT/footing trends and numerical audits
blocked_claim: Experimentally universal H/B law for any footing geometry and any MICP profile
residual_gap: Project PLT/FEM/limit-analysis calibration remains necessary for final geometry-specific design

AE_requirement: Localization fragility factor requires data support
primary_datasets: Konstantinou et al. fracture toughness evidence; Sarkis et al. microstructural heterogeneity and local deformation evidence; stress-path and durability/cyclic data as indirect support
data_role: Fragility/localization proxy only; provides a reason for sensitivity and falsification thresholds, not direct parameter identification
what_is_calibrated: Nothing as a fixed footing parameter
what_is_bounded: Reasonable sensitivity bands and warning thresholds when cementation continuity or post-peak response is uncertain
what_is_sensitized: Effect of brittle cemented contribution, microcracking, heterogeneity and localized deformation on usable MICP credit
not_identified: Direct post-peak localization parameter for degraded MICP footing capacity
allowed_claim: chi_s is a conservative sensitivity/falsification factor
blocked_claim: chi_s is an experimentally identified universal constant
residual_gap: Requires DIC/tomography/post-peak footing or elastoplastic back-analysis for direct identification

AE_requirement: Figures 2 and 4 should not be speculative and the model should be compared/calibrated with data
model_item: q_u(t), FS(H/B, lambda), beta(t), q_service,max, scenario envelopes
primary_datasets: Combined traceability chain above plus component calibration metrics, external quantitative validation, model hierarchy ablation, and external direct-bearing/degradation evidence table
data_role: Data-to-parameter traceability; transforms figures from unsupported forecasts into scenario predictions bounded by the available experimental evidence
evidence_status: SCENARIO PREDICTION BOUNDED BY MULTIPLE COMPONENT DATA STREAMS
what_is_calibrated: Initial bearing trend, load-settlement branch, selected degradation-retention priors, numerical saturation trend and reliability propagation
what_is_bounded: Parameter ranges and extrapolation warnings outside the evidence envelope
what_is_sensitized: Demand level, lambda_E, H/B, c_b0_prime, eta_r, chi_s and environmental severity
not_identified: Integrated long-term degraded MICP footing experiment validating all outputs simultaneously
blocked_claim: V5 direct physical degraded-footing validation or universal long-term design chart
residual_gap: A single integrated test campaign would be needed to claim direct V5 degraded-footing validation

AE_requirement: Overall validation level and universality must be stated honestly
primary_datasets: No single public integral dataset found; component evidence from PLT, triaxial/stress-path, durability/dissolution, field performance and microstructure/fracture
data_role: Defines validated component envelope and remaining V5 gap
evidence_status: GLOBAL-FORM TRACEABILITY; NOT DIRECT UNIVERSAL V5

what_is_bounded: Applicable use domain through measurable soil, geometry, cementation, exposure and fragility inputs
not_identified: Universal constants valid for all soils, climates and geometries
allowed_claim: Universal-form, locally parameterized framework with traceability and uncertainty bounds
blocked_claim: Global constants or direct V5 validation for every soil-climate-geometry combination
